notes.title: Version 2.0.0.0 - New Content
notes.notes:
- Added new area
- Added new items
- Removed bugs
- (Probably) introduced new bugs
- Added banners that can be used at the altar to more easily farm ressources

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.5
notes.notes:
- Melee Attacks should now feel much better with an enlarged and closer hitbox

- When starting a save, the initial workbench and chest can no longer be destroyed by tools other than a pickaxe

- Performance in the Voided Sanctum room has been improved

- Slightly reduced the offset of the camera when playing with controller for  less headaches

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.4
notes.notes:
- Placed items can now only be destroyed with pickaxes. This is to prevent e.g fiery boots from burning destroying the base. (Already placed items must be picked up and placed again for this change to take effect.)

- Pressing E multiple times no longer results in random teleportation across the world when interacting with portals.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.3 (Hotfix)
notes.notes: - Fixed a crash when interacting with the titans offering

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.2 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the fire from the Fire Boots would grow uncontrollably on low FPS
- Fixed game crashing when leaving a room while holding a passive buff item with the mouse cursor
- Fixed a buff where items can spawn out of reach / inside of a wall when killing enemies or bosses

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.1 (Hotfix)
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where destorying objects with spears crashed the game

notes.title: Dungeon Mage joins Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

At long last, Dungeon Mage enters the ranks of being a steam-game, which makes me super excited.
I've been working on Dungeon Mage for more than a year now and am really happy with how it turned out.

I'd love for it to contain more content and have a longer span of playtime, but the development of the game happened parallel to some health-difficulties. Not trying to be the Debbie Downer, of course - just trying to say that I'd love to eventually add more content if the game is received well! 

The game was tested and fed with a lot of cool ideas by the lovely peeps over on our discord, so feel free to join and let us know what you think! https://discord.gg/qe5FZbpFAE 

Thank your for your interest in Dungeon Mage and good luck down there!
